title: Commercial Fleet Telematics & EV Diagnostics
seo_title: Top Commercial EV Fleet Telematics & Vehicle Diagnostics Platforms
description: Commercial fleet telematics and vehicle diagnostics platforms capture high-frequency CAN bus telemetry, real-time battery State of Charge (SoC), and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) from commercial electric vehicles. As fleets transition from internal combustion engines to battery electric trucks, vans, and buses, traditional GPS tracking is insufficient. Fleet operators require deep vehicle integration to monitor battery State of Health (SoH), predict accurate real-world range based on payload and ambient temperatures, and assess fleet electrification readiness through Electric Vehicle Suitability Assessments (EVSA). Modern EV telematics platforms bridge vehicle telematics with depot charging infrastructure, passing live SoC and scheduled departure times via bi-directional APIs to depot charging management systems (CPMS). This automated synchronization ensures vehicles are fully charged without human intervention, minimizes driver range anxiety, and optimizes depot turnaround times.
